notes: items apply everywhere (filtered by zoneType); regions[emirate].items are the emirate's mainland licensing items; freeZones[zone].items apply to companies in that free zone. Economic Substance Regulations were repealed for periods ending after 31 December 2022 and are not included.

items.name: Corporate Tax Registration
items.rule: By the FTA deadline set by the licence issue date (new companies: within 3 months of incorporation)
items.applies: Every UAE company, free zone company and registered branch
items.description: Registration on EmaraTax gives the Tax Registration Number; missing the deadline carries an AED 10,000 penalty.

items.name: Corporate Tax Return and Payment
items.rule: Within 9 months after the end of the tax period (financial year)
items.applies: Every taxable person, even if no tax is due
items.description: Filed on EmaraTax; 9% above AED 375,000 of taxable income, 0% for qualifying income of Qualifying Free Zone Persons; Small Business Relief may apply for revenue up to AED 3 million (tax periods ending by 31 December 2026).
items.authority: Federal Tax Authority (FTA), Federal Decree-Law No. 47 of 2022

items.name: Audited Financial Statements for Corporate Tax
items.rule: Ready by the Corporate Tax return due date
items.applies: Businesses with revenue over AED 50 million, and every Qualifying Free Zone Person
items.description: Ministerial Decision No. 82 of 2023 requires audited financial statements for these taxpayers; they may be requested by the FTA.

items.name: VAT Registration
items.rule: Within 30 days once taxable supplies exceeded AED 375,000 in the last 12 months (or are expected to in the next 30 days)
items.description: Voluntary registration is possible from AED 187,500.
items.authority: Federal Tax Authority (FTA), Federal Decree-Law No. 8 of 2017

items.name: VAT Return and Payment (quarterly)
items.rule: By the 28th day of the month after each tax period (periods as assigned by the FTA; we assume they follow your financial year)
items.description: Filed on EmaraTax; payment is due by the same date.

items.name: VAT Return and Payment (monthly)
items.rule: By the 28th day of the month after each monthly tax period
items.description: Filed on EmaraTax; payment is due by the same date.

items.name: Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) Register Update
items.rule: Within 15 days of any change in beneficial ownership
items.applies: Companies and branches (mainland and free zone)
items.description: Cabinet Decision No. 109 of 2023 requires a UBO register, a partners/shareholders register and a nominee register, filed with the licensing authority and kept current.
items.authority: Licensing authority (Ministry of Economy / DED / free zone registrar)

items.name: AML/CFT Registration and goAML Reporting
items.rule: Before starting a designated activity; suspicious transactions reported without delay
items.applies: Designated non-financial businesses and professions (e.g. real estate, precious metals and stones, corporate service providers, auditors)
items.description: These businesses register on goAML with the Financial Intelligence Unit and keep an AML/CFT compliance programme.
items.authority: UAE Financial Intelligence Unit / Ministry of Economy

items.name: Transfer Pricing Disclosure Form and Master/Local File
items.rule: Disclosure filed with the Corporate Tax return; master and local files kept and provided within 30 days of an FTA request
items.applies: Businesses with related-party transactions (disclosure over AED 40 million; files if revenue is AED 200 million or more, or the group's is AED 3.15 billion or more)
items.description: Related-party and connected-person transactions must be at arm's length under Article 34 of the Corporate Tax Law.

items.name: Annual General Assembly and Audited Accounts (LLC)
items.rule: Within 4 months after financial year end
items.description: The general assembly approves the audited financial statements and the auditor's report under the Commercial Companies Law (Federal Decree-Law No. 32 of 2021).
items.authority: Commercial Companies Law (Federal Decree-Law No. 32 of 2021)

items.name: Ministry of Economy Branch Registration Renewal
items.rule: Annually, before the registration certificate expires
items.description: Renewal is filed with the audited branch accounts; the parent's good-standing documents are refreshed periodically.

items.name: Wage Protection System (WPS) Salary Payments
items.rule: Salaries paid through WPS each month, no later than 15 days after they fall due
items.description: Late or missing WPS payments lead to MOHRE penalties and a block on new work permits.
items.authority: Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (MOHRE)

items.name: Emiratisation Targets (50+ employees)
items.rule: +1% of skilled roles by 30 June and a further +1% by 31 December each year
items.applies: Mainland private companies with 50 or more employees
items.description: Unmet targets are charged monthly per missing Emirati (AED 9,000 a month in 2026); Emiratis must be registered with pension (GPSSA).

items.name: Emiratisation Target (20–49 employees, 14 sectors)
items.rule: Hire the required number of UAE nationals by 31 December each year
items.applies: Mainland companies with 20–49 employees in the 14 sectors named by MOHRE
items.description: Companies in scope must employ at least two UAE nationals from 2025 and keep them registered with pension.

items.name: Qualifying Free Zone Person Review
items.rule: Each tax period, with the Corporate Tax return
items.applies: Free zone companies claiming the 0% rate
items.description: Check substance in the free zone, qualifying income, the de minimis limit (non-qualifying revenue under 5% or AED 5 million) and transfer pricing; failing any condition removes the 0% rate for 5 years.

items.name: Pension Contributions for UAE and GCC National Employees
items.rule: By the 15th of the month after each salary month
items.applies: Employers of UAE nationals (GCC nationals under their home scheme)
items.description: Registration with GPSSA (or the Abu Dhabi Pension Fund for Abu Dhabi-based employers) is required when a national is hired; penalties accrue daily after the due date.
items.authority: General Pension and Social Security Authority (GPSSA) / Abu Dhabi Pension Fund

items.name: Employee Health Insurance and Work Permits
items.rule: Before each employee starts; renewed with visas
items.description: Health insurance is mandatory for employees across the UAE; work permits and residence visas are issued through MOHRE or the free zone authority.
items.authority: MOHRE / free zone authority / emirate health authority

items.name: DIFC Data Protection Notification Renewal

items.name: DEWS Employee Savings Contributions
items.rule: Monthly, for each month's salary
items.description: The DIFC Employee Workplace Savings scheme replaces end-of-service gratuity for employees in the DIFC.
